consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: near hit - chemical exposure at P-8302

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on P-8302, M-8302 and PT-8302 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. P-8302 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 26 January 2004 a near hit was recorded on P-8302, M-8302 and PT-8302 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during commissioning of replacement equipment; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
